content: It was implemented 11 years after the founding of the Fußball-Bundesliga as the new second division for professional football. The decision to establish the league as the second level of football in West Germany was made in May 1973. Bundesliga are directly promoted to the Bundesliga, while a third promoted club is determined through the play-offs, from 1974 to 1991 and again since 2008. The bottom clubs in the league are relegated to the third division; from 1974 to 1994, the Oberliga "Oberliga (football)"), from 1994 to 2008, the Regionalliga and since 2008, the 3. Since 2008 two clubs have been directly relegated while the third-last team has the opportunity to defend its league play in the play-offs against the third placed team of the 3.
